label: preparing
what: A discreet gathering in the great hall tomorrow at 18:00, with eight installed lanterns and 200 fresh loaves for the four tables. Builder explicitly requested it not be discussed with the mayor, coordinating baker, innkeeper and freight. Secretary is now knowingly helping clarify arrangements and the payer for 101 emeralds of committee credit, without authorizing town funds. A celebration of my forty years of service is plausible but not confirmed.
